items.question: Is the Opus 4.8 tier change verified and documented, or re-applied?
options: Verify and document it; treat 599bdca as the delivery (the agent files already say Opus 4.8 high; only docs and the ledger table disagree)

items.question: Who writes the orchestrator's spawn.usage and spawn.end rows?
options: The supervisor writes spawn.usage (agent, role, result); the hook writes the orchestrator's spawn.end
Keep the supervisor's spawn.end and have the hook skip orchestrators (no orchestrator usage, against the entry)
Both write spawn.end (the second row finds no open node at src/watch/ledger.ts:241 and its result is lost)

items.question: Which runs does usage sum for a ledger?
options: Every run in the ledger, flat
The last run only, as --watch does

items.question: Where do the model profiles live at runtime?
options: Ship inside dist/; ledger.ts resolves them relative to its own module, empty table on absence
Import through resolveJsonModule from harness/ (outside rootDir ./src)

items.question: What does usage return?
options: Text in message and numbers in data
